blockingFindings.title: R6 stale task assertion fails on the implemented rejection
blockingFindings.issue: The R6 test includes a stale artifact with `taskId: "T-1"`, but the `assert.throws` matcher only accepts messages matching `/phase|tree|state/i`. The implementation rejects that artifact with `provider artifact task target does not match flow-level state`, so the test fails even though the task mismatch is rejected.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Update the R6 mismatch assertion in `gate-fail-closed.test.js` to accept task-target mismatch errors, for example `/phase|task|tree|state/i`, or split the taskId mismatch into its own assertion that checks for the task-target rejection.
blockingFindings.rationale: R6 requires flow-level recovery to register only taskId-null artifacts and reject mismatched targets. A failing R6 coverage test blocks validation of the mandatory recovery behavior, and the failure is caused by the test matcher excluding the expected task mismatch rejection.
